title: OpenRA
summary: OpenRA is an open-source reimplementation of the classic Command & Conquer: Red Alert game engine that enables players to enjoy classic RTS games on modern operating systems with improved compatibility and cross-platform support.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of running classic Command & Conquer games on modern hardware and operating systems where the original games no longer function properly.
why_valuable: OpenRA preserves gaming history by making classic RTS games playable on modern systems while adding quality-of-life improvements like multiplayer support and modding capabilities.
